content.comment_body: Hello, I am unable to connect to my [product_name] [article_no] using the USB interface cable and my PC with [product_name] V6.1. When powering on the device, I do not see the (PC-device) symbol and the software only offers modem connections. Thank you.
To start, I recommend posting your question in English since the forum mainly uses this language. I tried translating, but my French isn't very strong.

First, a few questions: What operating system are you using? Is this an original [company_name] [product_name] USB cable or a converter? If the software interface selection only lists internal modems (like COM3), the USB cable isn't installed correctly. Be sure to install the driver first, then plug in the cable. If you mixed up the order, uninstall the USB cable driver (there are two entries in the software manager), restart your PC, reinstall the driver, and finally reconnect the cable.

I've had similar issues since using this software. The software itself works well, and Windows detects the interface, but when trying to connect to the [product_name], nothing happens and [product_name] becomes unresponsive. I tried all the suggestions here but couldn't establish communication. The quickest fix was using another laptop—on this second, identical laptop (same brand and OS), it worked immediately. It's inconvenient but effective. Good luck!

analysis.insight_summary: Users are having trouble connecting a [product_name] [article_no] device to a PC using a [company_name] USB cable with [product_name] V6.1. The software only shows modem connections and doesn't detect the USB cable, indicating a driver installation or detection issue. Another user confirms similar problems, where the interface is detected by Windows but the connection fails, causing the software to hang. Using the same software and cable on a different but identical laptop resolves the issue, hinting at system compatibility inconsistencies.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the PC and [product_name] [article_no] device to be automatically detected and to communicate smoothly via the provided USB cable and [product_name] V6.1, with clear feedback and easy setup from the software.
